caption:
🙋🏻‍♀️Hi I’m Min, a pediatric dietitian mom,  here to share creative baby food combos that go beyond the usual purees and are deeply nourishing.

This creamy sardine hummus is perfect for babies 6 months and up and can be served in so many ways: on a preloaded spoon, spread on toast, or as a dip for soft-cooked veggies.
The more variety we offer our little ones early on, the more opportunities they have to explore new flavors and textures without pressure. And yes, babies can absolutely enjoy flavorful foods, too so don’t hold back on seasoning their food.
